queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries were performed. They found official Sudan Judiciary/Aqari, NIC spatial-portal, Sudan Judiciary land-registration, and state surveying material, but no Mellit-specific public parcel service.
requestOutcomes: Aqari returned HTTP 502; the NIC-linked geoportal host failed DNS resolution; the Judiciary page returned HTTP 521/unknown status; the Gezira surveying page was readable but had no public parcel route. No authenticated or unsafe request was made.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [14.1372561619297, 25.5504258894349] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not moved.
No exact-point lookup or map-extent conclusion was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
National Judiciary/Aqari descriptions and general agency prose do not establish a Mellit or North Darfur local registry.
No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or native identity was verified; no sample GeoJSON is included.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, title, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: No Mellit-specific first-party public parcel response was verified during this attempt; research is complete but source admission is not justified.

uncertainty: The national spatial portal may be temporarily unavailable or may require a route not exposed by the NIC project page, and local records may be non-public. These limitations are recorded as unavailable evidence, not as proof that Mellit lacks cadastral records.
